edges.reason: mint calls the internal _mint routine to perform the actual minting.
freeRollMint calls the internal _mint routine after consuming free rolls.
mint calls numTotal9021s to enforce the collection supply cap.
freeRollMint calls numTotal9021s to compute remaining supply.
getcostForMinting9021s calls numTotal9021s for the supply check.
_mint calls useRandomAvailableToken for each token to mint.
useRandomAvailableToken resolves the chosen index via useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
tokenURI reads the base URI through _baseURI.
startSale sets isSaleOn to true.
startSale permanently flags saleHasBeenStarted.
endSale sets isSaleOn to false.
setPrice writes the new value into _price.
giveFreeRoll updates the freeRoll9021s balance of the receiver.
giveFreeRoll increments the _numFreeRollsGiven counter.
setBaseURI writes _baseTokenURI.
setContractURI writes contractURI9021.
setImageHash writes imageHash.
_mint writes back the decremented _numAvailableTokens.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex mutates the _availableTokens array entries.
_mint invokes _safeMint which performs an external onERC721Received callback to contract recipients.
withdrawSplit performs an unchecked low-level call to coOwner1 before completing full accounting.
withdrawSplit performs a low-level call to coOwner2 which can re-enter.
withdrawFailsafe forwards the entire balance to msg.sender via low-level call vulnerable to reentrancy.
freeRollMint reads freeRoll9021s[msg.sender] and zeroes the caller's balance.
mint uses msg.sender for the refund transfer and as the mint recipient.
useRandomAvailableToken hashes msg.sender into the pseudo-random seed.
withdrawFailsafe sends the whole balance to the caller-derived msg.sender address.
The refund transfer targets msg.sender, allowing a callback into the caller.
msg.sender is incorporated into the weak randomness seed, making it manipulable.
The failsafe call sends value to msg.sender, which can re-enter.
block.timestamp is fed into the token id derivation, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is part of the keccak256 randomness seed, allowing miner influence.
mint triggers the excess-payment refund transfer to the caller.
mint reads _price to compute the required payment.
mint gates execution on the isSaleOn flag.
getPrice returns the stored _price.
getcostForMinting9021s multiplies the requested quantity by _price.
_mint enforces the MAX_MINTABLE_AT_ONCE batch limit.
useRandomAvailableToken takes the modulo by _numAvailableTokens.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex reads and decrements _numAvailableTokens.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex reads token slots from _availableTokens.
coOwner1 is the recipient of the low-level payout call.
coOwner2 is the recipient of the low-level payout call.
_baseURI returns the stored _baseTokenURI.
contractURI returns contractURI9021.
_numToMint parameter flows into the supply, cost and batch logic of mint.
_numToMint parameter controls the _mint loop bound.
_numToFetch parameter is hashed into the randomness seed.
_i loop index is hashed into the randomness seed.
indexToUse parameter selects the available token slot to consume.
_numToMint parameter is used in the cost and supply checks.
_owner parameter determines whose token balances are enumerated.
_tokenId parameter is formatted into the returned token URI.
_newPrice parameter is assigned to _price.
receiver parameter indexes the freeRoll9021s mapping.
numRolls parameter is accumulated into the receiver balance and global counter.
baseURI parameter is stored into _baseTokenURI.
_contractURI parameter is stored into contractURI9021.
_imageHash parameter is stored into imageHash.
owner parameter indexes the freeRoll9021s lookup.
local totalSupply caches the supply for the mint cap check.
local costForMinting9021s drives the payment validation and refund in mint.
local toMint is the amount passed to _mint in freeRollMint.
local remaining clamps the free roll mint amount.
local updatedNumAvailableTokens is written back to state in _mint.
local newTokenId is passed to _safeMint inside _mint.
local randomNum holds the keccak256 seed value.
local randomIndex selects the token slot via modulo.
local result is the token id returned by useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
local _balance is split between the two co-owner calls.
local num9021s bounds the enumeration loop in get9021sBelongingToOwner.
